title: Restored Reply Embeds and Reliable Sync
summary: Customer reply embeds are restored and Raven deployments now replace stale guild commands with retry handling.
changed: Restored the anonymous Delta Support embed sent to customers by /reply.
Kept the responding member's attributed embed in the private support ticket.
Guild sync now clears stale command definitions before publishing this release's command set.
Command sync retries temporary Discord HTTP failures up to three times.
General public moderation, activity logging, and lounge AutoMod remain removed.
